---
title: "Caribou cumulative effects disturbance report"
output: html_document

---
  
###### Date: `r format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")`

This document report the disturbed and undisturbed areas for caribou herds located in the Southeastern Yukon. 

For each herd, the application compiles a consistent set of spatial layers used to represent both natural and anthropogenic disturbances, as well as land use context. 
These layers are used within the app to visualize disturbance patterns, support comparisons, and enable cumulative effects assessment. It is possible for the user to add extra linear and/or areal disturbances as well as display elements as vector and/or raster format.

To generate and preview the report, please select a herd/range  and run the analysis.
